Sver the Trapper

Biography

Sver the Trapper is an experienced Ingos hunter who knows the Woodsfolk and their customs. He helps Zak investigate the murdered Snoop and explains how to gain the Green Clan’s trust. He also resents Karansul’s control over the fur trade. In return for help selling his skins, Sver reveals the merchant’s concealed accounts and recommends the thief Trickster. [1, 2, 3, 4]
